parole.significato: to grumble, complain, moan, whine (express feelings of pain, dissatisfaction, or resentment)
parole.testo: From Byzantine Greek γκρινιάζω (nkriniázō), γρινιάζω (griniázō). Either from γκρίνια (gkrínia, “moaning, complaining”) + -άζω (-ázo) (but possibly vice versa, a back-formation of γκρίνια from the verb).
